definitions.explanation: The act of verifying or making sure something is correct or true.

examples.japanese: ⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦もう→もう：00602_mou⟧⟦{一度|いちど}→一度：01312_ichido⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦します→する：00392_suru⟧。
{確認|かくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れました→取れる：02376_toreru⟧。

notes:
{確認|かくにん} means confirmation or verification—the act of making sure something is correct.

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{他動詞|たどうし}→他動詞：10418_tadoushi⟧ (transitive)
- No standard intransitive pair
- Pattern: [noun]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧

COMMON PATTERNS:
Used as a suru verb: {確認|かくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to confirm, to verify)
- 〜⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to confirm/check ~
- {確認|かくにん}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}れる→取れる：02376_toreru⟧: to get confirmation
- ⟦ご→ご：09882_go⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: please confirm (polite)
- {確認|かくにん}⟦{済|ず}み→済み：04013_zumi⟧: confirmed, verified

COMPOUNDS:
- {確認|かくにん}⟦{事項|じこう}→事項：11469_jikou⟧: items to confirm
- {確認|かくにん}⟦{作業|さぎょう}→作業：02775_sagyou⟧: verification work
- ⟦{最終|さいしゅう}→最終：02820_saishuu⟧{確認|かくにん}: final confirmation
- ⟦{本人|ほんにん}→本人：03627_honnin⟧{確認|かくにん}: identity verification

USAGE:
Extremely common in business contexts for double-checking information, appointments, and orders.

ASPECT (ている):
- [X]⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{確認|かくにん}⟦している→する：00392_suru⟧: has confirmed X / is verifying X (context-dependent — can be progressive or resultative)
- {確認|かくにん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧: has been confirmed (passive resultative — the fact/item is now in a verified state)
- {確認|かくにん}⟦していない→する：00392_suru⟧: has not yet confirmed
- Note: The て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form of {確認|かくにん}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ has two readings depending on context. With a specific object and a deliberative context, it often means the progressive "is checking." But when reporting a status (e.g., "the payment has been confirmed"), it functions as a resultative. The passive {確認|かくにん}⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧ is unambiguously resultative and is very common in business reports.
